Spec review: one partial requirement.

- `src/lib/sightings.integration.test.ts:16` conditionally defines the entire real-PostgreSQL suite only when `DATABASE_URL` exists. With the normal `bun run test` environment (no `DATABASE_URL`), Vitest reports all 5 integration tests as absent/skipped, yet the command passes. This does not prove the criterion “Real-PostgreSQL tests prove literal-weekday and deterministic distinct evidence reads,” nor the issue’s required real-PostgreSQL acceptance gate. CI/build configuration in this diff does not force `DATABASE_URL` or run the integration suite separately.

Otherwise implementation matches the requested planner behavior: literal weekday SQL, distinct date/minute evidence, inclusive non-wrapping windows, date/candidate dedupe, precedence and evidence gates, exact 3/2 scoring inequalities with ties, labels/coaching/failure handling, client-clock defaults/recalculation, two-destination nav, accessibility/mobile tests, and no historical-grid exposure. Pure fixtures cover the listed scoring and edge cases; all local typecheck/tests pass. No scope creep or incorrect planner behavior found.

VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Authoritative CI evidence resolves the PostgreSQL concern: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` provisions PostgreSQL and sets `DATABASE_URL`; PR run `31513159870` executed the integration suite (7 tests), with 70 tests passing. No remaining Spec findings.

VERDICT: READY
